title: FilterStats
description: Statistics from a single filter stage execution.

stage_order.description: Execution order of this stage in the filter pipeline.

items_in.description: Number of items presented to this stage.

items_passed.description: Number of items that passed this stage.

items_rejected.description: Number of items rejected by this stage.

rejection_reasons.description: Count of rejections by reason string.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of this stage in milliseconds.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings produced by this stage.
